tool: built-in image_gen; user-authorized Pillow/NumPy alpha cleanup
method: Action taxonomy, per-sheet prompts, four transparent still atlases, then connected matte and clipped chroma removal. Surviving RGB pixels are unchanged. No video or GIF encoding.

review.technical: 32 cells checked in browser on light and dark backgrounds and in native Electron. See validation notes.
review.aesthetic: White matte and colored speckles removed with a constrained alpha mask; inspected on light/dark backgrounds. Character design is unchanged. This is an engineering visual review, not a claim of user art approval.
